description: This Java class is a Spring REST controller that handles HTTP requests related to 'Question' entities, providing endpoints to list, create, update, and delete questions.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: Spring REST controller managing CRUD operations for Question entities, mapped to '/questions' endpoints.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question by ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a question by ID.
